method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading and reverse paraphrase of the configuration, step, run and output definitions, with exact formula, macro, token, identifier and reference parity. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Finite tape configuration C,m,q; position-one initial tuple; one-step transition cases; halting and output extraction, including documented source boundary gaps.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A configuration of M=(Q,Sigma,q0,delta) is (C,m,q), where C is a finite Sigma-string, m is a natural number strictly below its length, and q is in Q. C lists tape content through the last nonblank or visited square, m indexes the scanned square from zero, and q is the current state.
samples.checks: All tuple members, domain conditions, strict bound and indexing origin are unchanged. The inherited file ID cmp/tur/con is preserved even though the enclosing chapter driver uses tur/mac.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For input I in Sigma-star, the formal initial tuple is (end-marker concatenated with I, 1, q0), placing the head on the first input square immediately right of the marker. Empty I needs an included first blank square to satisfy m<len(C).
samples.checks: The displayed tuple and concatenation symbol are unchanged. OLTUR-002 records the earlier section's conflicting head-at-marker convention; OLTUR-003 resolves the frozen side-of-marker gloss; OLTUR-004 identifies the empty-input strict-bound gap.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A one-step yield reads sigma at m, applies delta(q,sigma)=(q prime,sigma prime,D), writes sigma prime at m, moves left with a zero boundary, right or stays, extends C by one blank square if the new position reaches its old length, and leaves all other old symbols unchanged.
samples.checks: All six numbered clauses and three movement subclauses retain their exact formulas, order and inequalities.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A run is a configuration sequence starting at C0, each yielding the next. The machine halts at k when the scanned transition is undefined. Output O is the nonblank-suffixed string satisfying C=end-marker concatenated with O and j blanks; if all content after the marker is blank, O is empty.
samples.checks: The halting criterion, step count, output equation, blank exponent and empty-output case are preserved. OLTUR-005 clarifies that the stated decomposition directly applies only when the end marker survived, because earlier sections permit overwriting it.

source_observations: OLTUR-002 through OLTUR-005 document two cross-section convention conflicts, a directional gloss ambiguity and an empty-input boundary gap; frozen English and all displayed formulas remain unchanged.
T339's स्थितिवर्णन names the full tape-state-head triple under the source definition; no unrelated legal or metallurgical configuration gloss was imported.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The source does not specify a complete output convention for runs that overwrite the end marker; the Marathi text discloses this limit rather than inventing one.
The source's initial head convention conflicts with an earlier informal sentence; a single global choice remains for expert review.
No TeX reader build was run for this incomplete chapter.
